content:
In the space of just over two hours, the president’s account shared roughly 25 posts. They began appearing after Trump’s rally in Alaska, while the president was aboard Air Force One en route to Las Vegas.

The barrage of posts came as Trump faces some of the worst polling of his second term. The content ranged from attacks on his perceived political enemies to posts promoting and defending his own policies and agenda.

Some hyped the deportation of migrants, while others featured Fox News hosts and top administration officials lavishing praise on the president.

One video declared that “God made Trump,” portraying the president as a divinely chosen “caretaker” tasked with protecting the country.

The spree began at 12:10 a.m. ET, with a video comparing Trump to a lion, a possible callback to the fatal tiger attack-themed posts he had shared, and drawn condemnation for, just hours earlier.
